messages:
Maya Chen: Quick heads-up — SummitPay just flagged that multiple webhook deliveries started returning 401 after their credential rotation yesterday. They hit this on staging and prod. Renewal review is next week; they're worried this is a blocker. Can we triage async?

Marcus Liu: I'm on it. Any sample logs or failing request payloads?

Riley Thompson: Seen the errors in our ingress logs — signature verification failing (HMAC mismatch). Looks like their new key uses a different formatting (base64 vs hex) in the signature header. Pasting a simplified failing request: 

```
POST /callbacks/payment HTTP/1.1
Host: api.redwood.example
X-Summit-Sig: sha256=8f9d... (got from customer)
Authorization: Bearer xxxx

Response: 401 Unauthorized - signature verification failed
```

Samir Kaur: tagging eng-runtime + eng-security for confirmation: @Marcus @Riley — could this be our signature parser being strict about header format?

Marcus Liu: Probable. Our verification code expects hex-encoded digest. If SummitPay switched to base64-encoded digest on rotation, our parser rejects it. I'll add a tolerant branch to accept both encodings for the signature header.

deploy-bot: deployment queued: runtime/verify-signature-fix -> canary (by Marcus)

Ava Patel: Customer-facing note: SummitPay is asking if we can do a one-off patch so they can proceed with rollout today. Renewal touchpoint on Wed — if we don't demonstrate quick mitigation, risk increases.

Riley Thompson: I can reproduce locally with a base64 signature. Marcus, minimal change is: try base64 decode if hex parse fails, then compare. I'll attach the test case in code review.

Marcus Liu: Plan: 1) push canary that accepts both hex and base64 signatures constrained to SummitPay org id; 2) run canary for 1 hour and monitor 401 rate; 3) roll to region if stable. ETA for canary push: ~2.5h.

Maya Chen: Sounds good. I'll tell the customer we'll attempt a targeted canary and share logs. Ava — can you confirm which org id and endpoints we should target?

Ava Patel: SummitPay org id: org_74c. Target endpoints: /callbacks/payment and /callbacks/refund. I'll send a short note asking them to try a few test deliveries during the canary window.

Samir Kaur: Also suggestion: add a defensive metric for signature-decoding-fallbacks (hex->base64) so we can detect other customers hitting the same issue. I'll open a small ticket to add the metric and a dashboard tile.

Riley Thompson: Quick local test command that repros the failure for our infra folks: 

```bash
curl -X POST https://staging.api.redwood.example/callbacks/payment \\n  -H 'X-Summit-Sig: sha256=bWVzc2FnZWRpZ2VzdHJpbmc=' \\n  -d '{"id":"evt_12345"}' -v
# returns 401 with current parser
```

Marcus Liu: Noted. I'll scope the change to a single file in runtime verification with unit tests. Will post PR link when ready.

Maya Chen: Blockers: need eng approval for targeting canary to org_74c; need docs update for webhook signing formats; need time window from SummitPay to validate.

Marcus Liu: I'll request the canary permission now. If approved, I'll kick canary by 10:00 PST and update here.

Ava Patel: SummitPay asked if we can also provide a short rollback plan. Proposed rollback: disable tolerant parser and redeploy previous runtime within 15m — tested. I'll confirm with infra to have the image tagged and ready.

Samir Kaur: Follow-ups: (1) add dashboard alert for spike in 401s for webhook endpoints, (2) document recommended rotation steps (format examples), (3) include this case in renewal notes for the CSM. I'll own (2) and (3).

Marcus Liu: PR: https://git.internal.redwood/p/runtime/merge_requests/432 — includes tests + canary config for org_74c. Requesting review from @Riley and @Samir.

Maya Chen: Great. I'll update the customer: tentative canary 10:00 PST, expected mitigation within ~1 hour after canary start. Ava will send the customer the rollback plan and test instructions.

Ava Patel: Sending note now. I'll follow up with a short async recap after the canary. :thumbsup:

Riley Thompson: I'll watch logs during canary and post a summary.

Maya Chen: Thanks team. If anything blocks the canary (infra or code), ping here and we'll escalate to oncall.

(End of thread)
